#!/bin/bash
# Installs the ingest or token-publisher container on a VM that has a managed
# identity. The script does not print tokens.
set -euo pipefail

ENV_FILE="${1:?env file}"
ROLE="${2:?role}"

set -a
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source "$ENV_FILE"
set +a

if [[ -n "${PROJECTS_CONFIG_PATH:-}" && -f "${PROJECTS_CONFIG_PATH}" ]]; then
  python3 -m json.tool "$PROJECTS_CONFIG_PATH" >/dev/null
fi

systemctl enable --now docker
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 2
done
docker info >/dev/null

REGISTRY="${INGEST_IMAGE%%/*}"
if [[ "$REGISTRY" == *.azurecr.io ]]; then
  if [[ -z "${AZURE_CLIENT_ID:-}" ]]; then
    echo "AZURE_CLIENT_ID is required to pull from Azure Container Registry" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  META="http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://containerregistry.azure.net&client_id=${AZURE_CLIENT_ID}"
  ACCESS="$(curl -sS -H Metadata:true "$META" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])')"
  printf '%s' "$ACCESS" | docker login "$REGISTRY" -u 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --password-stdin >/dev/null
  unset ACCESS
fi

docker pull "$INGEST_IMAGE"

if [[ "$ROLE" == "publisher" ]]; then
  NAME="atlas-sentinel-token-publisher"
  ENTRY="--entrypoint /atlas-sentinel-token-publisher"
else
  NAME="atlas-sentinel-ingest"
  ENTRY=""
fi

cat >/etc/systemd/system/${NAME}.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=MongoDB Atlas Sentinel ${ROLE}
After=docker.service network-online.target
Requires=docker.service

[Service]
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm -f ${NAME}
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --name ${NAME} --network host --env-file ${ENV_FILE} ${ENTRY} ${INGEST_IMAGE}
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker stop ${NAME}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now "$NAME"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Seeds App Configuration with one JSON document per Atlas project.
# Prints counts only. PROJECTS_JSON is identifiers, not credentials.
set -euo pipefail

: "${APPCONFIG_ENDPOINT:?}"
: "${PROJECTS_JSON:?}"

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time

raw = os.environ["PROJECTS_JSON"]
lowered = raw.lower()
for banned in ("begin private key", "begin rsa private key", "client_secret=", "accountkey="):
    if banned in lowered:
        sys.exit("projects JSON contains secret material and was not written")

doc = json.loads(raw)
projects = doc["projects"] if isinstance(doc, dict) else doc
if not isinstance(projects, list) or not projects:
    sys.exit("projects JSON must contain a non-empty projects array")

endpoint = os.environ["APPCONFIG_ENDPOINT"]
want = {}
for project in projects:
    group = project["atlasGroupId"].lower()
    want[f"atlas-sentinel/project/{group}"] = json.dumps(project, separators=(",", ":"))

def az(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["az", *args], check=False, capture_output=True, text=True)

listed = None
for attempt in range(1, 13):
    listed = az(
        "appconfig", "kv", "list",
        "--endpoint", endpoint,
        "--auth-mode", "login",
        "--key", "atlas-sentinel/project/*",
        "--fields", "key",
        "-o", "json",
    )
    if listed.returncode == 0:
        break
    time.sleep(15)
if listed is None or listed.returncode != 0:
    sys.stderr.write((listed.stderr if listed else "list failed")[-500:])
    sys.exit(1)

existing = [row.get("key") for row in json.loads(listed.stdout or "[]")]
for key, value in want.items():
    result = az(
        "appconfig", "kv", "set",
        "--endpoint", endpoint,
        "--auth-mode", "login",
        "--key", key,
        "--value", value,
        "--yes",
        "-o", "none",
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(result.stderr[-500:])
        sys.exit(result.returncode)
for key in existing:
    if key and key not in want:
        result = az(
            "appconfig", "kv", "delete",
            "--endpoint", endpoint,
            "--auth-mode", "login",
            "--key", key,
            "--yes",
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            sys.stderr.write(result.stderr[-500:])
            sys.exit(result.returncode)
print(f"seeded {len(want)} projects")
PY
